products.name: Fire Deficiency Resolution Desk
products.product: A focused fire protection inspection deficiency tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small fire-alarm, sprinkler, extinguisher, and life-safety inspection contractors
products.problem: Deficiencies leave inspection reports but estimates, approvals, repair scheduling, retest evidence, and final documentation are handled in separate systems.
products.valueProposition: Turns fire protection inspection deficiency tracking into a visible operating queue so every recorded deficiency reaches an authorized resolution, verified retest, or documented customer decision.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets fire protection inspection deficiency tracking software, fire protection inspection deficiency tracking tracker, fire protection inspection deficiency tracking template, and fire protection inspection deficiency tracking checklist searches.
